confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant meal, coffee and draught beer anchors agree roughly across Numbeo's Bruges pages (labelled Oct 2026), HikersBay and World-Prices (not independent of each other), though their figures differ by up to 40 percent or more. Beer is set for a standard restaurant serving, not the 0.5 L measure aggregators quote. Cocktail and wine by the glass are weakest: cocktail rests on one Bruges guide and restaurant mixed-drink listings, cross-checked at about 3x restaurant draught beer; wine rests on restaurant menus and a wine-bar listing, some undated or old, cross-checked at about 1.7x beer. Bottle-price aggregates were not used because they reflect shop prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July demand, not checked against live listings or any search. Euro prices were converted at an approximate working rate, not a live quote. FX is the 18 Nov 2026 4pm AUD/USD figure seen in search summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages; the F11 table was not opened and no 19 Nov figure was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Bruges-specific aggregates and Bruges listings; Numbeo Brussels and Kortrijk comparison figures were used only as spread checks. Accommodation uses no named comparable city, only a model judgement for a small, heavily visited Flemish heritage city in summer.
